head: Frames makes your camera roll searchable and editable, all on your phone
dek: Frames turns your camera roll into a library you can search and an editor to work in, with everything processed on your device. It was #37 among free Photo & Video apps on the US App Store on 6 November.
details: Your photos never leave your phone, the listing says. It's free with in-app purchases, by Tyler Andrew Haven.
means: If your camera roll is a mess, it organizes it without uploading anything.
todo: Find Frames in the App Store.
